Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. I’m sorry to hear how disappointed and stressed you felt by the delay.

We aimed for the clinician who already knew the background to contact you, so you could get a clear, consistent explanation without needing to repeat a complex situation to someone unfamiliar with your case. Unfortunately, we were experiencing exceptionally high demand at the time, including a significant seasonal illness/flu surge, and had to prioritise urgent clinical work. This meant we couldn’t call as quickly as we had hoped, and the next available appointment with the appropriate clinician was later than we would have liked.

eConsult is also not intended for urgent issues. If something is clinically urgent, please contact reception directly so we can triage you appropriately.

For confidentiality reasons we can’t discuss individual cases publicly, but we would like the opportunity to address your concerns. Please contact the practice and we will ensure this is reviewed and explained.

My father is a stroke survivor who sometimes struggles to remember the names of things and gets muddled up, and he is self-conscious about this enough already.
